NoeEngine is a multi-platform 2D and 3D game engine. It provides a huge set of common tools, so you can just focus on making your game without reinventing the wheel.
NoeEngine is derived from the free and open-source Godot engine under the MIT license. No strings attached, no royalties, nothing. Your game is yours, down to the last line of engine code.
